description: The bar chart titled "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks" compares the performance of two models, LLLaMA-3-8B-it and "Ours (Iterative RLHF)," across various academic and practical benchmarks. The horizontal axis lists the datasets and metrics, including GSM-8K, MLMU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis represents the score percentage, ranging from 0 to 80. The LLLaMA-3-8B-it model is represented by blue bars, while the "Ours (Iterative RLHF)" model is represented by orange bars. The chart shows that the LLLaMA-3-8B-it model generally outperforms the "Ours (Iterative RLHF)" model across most benchmarks, with the highest score being 80% on GSM-8K and the lowest being 20% on Chat-Arena-Hard. The "Ours (Iterative RLHF)" model shows more consistent performance, with scores ranging from 20% to 60% across the benchmarks. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on particular bars.
